title: Raccoon reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Book -->
  <rect x="28" y="62" width="44" height="30" rx="2" fill="#e85d4a"/>
  <rect x="28" y="62" width="44" height="30" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#ff8a75" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="50" y2="92" stroke="#ffb3a0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Book pages -->
  <rect x="31" y="65" width="17" height="24" rx="1" fill="#fff4d6"/>
  <rect x="52" y="65" width="17" height="24" rx="1" fill="#fff4d6"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="34" y1="70" x2="45" y2="70" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="74" x2="45" y2="74" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="78" x2="45" y2="78" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="70" x2="66" y2="70" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="74" x2="66" y2="74" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="55" y1="78" x2="66" y2="78" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Raccoon body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#8b7d9e"/>

  <!-- Raccoon head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#9a8caf"/>

  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="27" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#7a6d8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="27" rx="8" ry="9" fill="#7a6d8f"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="27" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#e8a0b0"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="27" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#e8a0b0"/>

  <!-- Mask around eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#3d3350"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="40" rx="12" ry="8" fill="#3d3350"/>

  <!-- White face patches -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#e8e0f0"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="40" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#e8e0f0"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="40" r="4" fill="#2a2040"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="40" r="4" fill="#2a2040"/>
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="38.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="49" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#3d3350"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="48.5" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#6a5a80"/>

  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M46 52 Q50 56 54 52" fill="none" stroke="#3d3350" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- White muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="52" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#e8e0f0" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="72" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#9a8caf"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="72" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#9a8caf"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#e8a0b0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="70" r="2.5" fill="#e8a0b0" opacity="0.5"/>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M72 70 Q88 65 85 50 Q82 40 75 45" fill="none" stroke="#8b7d9e" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 70 Q88 65 85 50 Q82 40 75 45" fill="none" stroke="#3d3350" stroke-width="8" stroke-dasharray="4 4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
